headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Dependency Risk Analysis
summary: Integrate real-time dependency risk analysis to provide instant feedback on potential vulnerabilities and security issues, ensuring a safer development environment. Improve user experience by offering granular control over package installation, and expand support for additional package managers like Go and Ruby.
actions: Implement real-time vulnerability scanning during the install process to alert users of any known risks associated with the packages they are about to install.
Add a feature that allows users to customize their risk tolerance levels, providing different levels of detail and severity alerts based on their preferences.
Expand ClearInstall’s compatibility to support Go and Ruby package managers, ensuring a consistent experience across multiple programming languages.
